title: Models older than Claude 4.6 carry a US-inference price multiplier they cannot incur
foundBy: session agent, auditing `pricing.json` against the provider price pages fetched on 2026-09-29; filed at the host's request: "file ledger entries in the tracer repo to report any issues with the pricing"
details:
The entries for Claude Opus 4.5, 4.1 and 4, Sonnet 4.5 and 4, Haiku 4.5 and Haiku 3.5 carry `geoMultipliers: {"us": 1.1}`. The provider's price page fetched on 2026-09-29 applies that multiplier to Claude 4.6 and later models only. It says earlier models reject `inference_geo` with a 400.

A transcript on those models cannot record US inference, so no estimate is wrong today. The entries still state a price the provider does not charge, and another tool that reads the table would inherit the error.
